tasks.short: Lead school diversity and understanding efforts

steps.what: Initiate diversity efforts by listening to school communities and agreeing practical priorities
Direct school efforts that build tolerance, understanding and appreciation of diversity

tasks.design: Keep community listening and leadership with the psychologist. Existing school material in {DOCS} can support the work; no programme-writing or reporting baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shared priorities depend on participation and trust.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools do not establish less effort in leading community change.
tasks.still_hard: Different experiences of exclusion require careful discussion and action.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist recognises tensions and brings people into the effort.
tasks.altitude: No change to leadership time or school decision rights.

evidence.claim: Community leadership and participation remain human work; no document-production saving is inferred.

assumptions: Boundary is initiating and directing efforts, excluding separately commissioned materials and school administration.
Community participants provide concerns during the retained listening work. No machine step requires structured identity or diversity labels.
No implementation or extra upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which groups need a different way to participate in setting priorities?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. Listening and practical leadership remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain child development and educational implications

steps.what: Promote understanding of child development and its relationship to learning and behavior through discussion

tasks.design: Retain the psychologist's explanation and response to questions. Existing professional materials in {DOCS} support discussion, while developmental interpretation and individual advice remain personal.
tasks.previous_blocker: People need help connecting general knowledge to their situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Access to text does not establish understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Developmental differences can be misread or reduced to simplistic labels.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist adjusts explanations and checks the implications people draw.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in explanatory effort or professional authority.

evidence.claim: Developmental explanation remains human communication; a separately written handout is not presumed.

assumptions: Boundary is explaining developmental knowledge, excluding new clinical assessment and material authoring.
Participants raise questions during retained s1; existing professional sources remain unchanged upstream. No machine input contract is needed.
No deployment or additional upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100, zero upkeep. Personal explanation remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop individual educational plans with staff

steps.what: Review individual educational needs and formulate proposed goals and supports
Collaborate with teachers and staff to agree feasible educational goals and responsibilities
Enter agreed goals, supports and responsibilities into the educational plan document
Check that the final individualized educational plan faithfully reflects the collaboration

tasks.design: Configure {DOCS} plan fields to render goals and responsibilities already agreed with staff. The psychologist retains needs interpretation, collaboration and final fidelity checks; no model selects supports or decides eligibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed details are copied into a fixed plan format.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document forms can reuse captured plan fields.
tasks.still_hard: Support choices and realistic responsibilities need contextual agreement.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist connects assessed needs with feasible support and checks that the plan expresses it.
tasks.altitude: Less plan transcription; educational and clinical decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: A fixed document form can render already agreed plan fields; the labour estimate is an E1 scenario and does not claim automated educational planning.

assumptions: Boundary is the psychologist's plan contribution through internal acceptance, excluding assessment administration, formal entitlement decisions and later teaching delivery. Staff collaboration remains unchanged and earns no other-role saving.

Psychologist captures student ID, plan period, agreed goal text, support text, responsible role, review date and agreed measures in s2's full 20 hours, using proposed content from s1. Missing fields or nonstandard plans are completed manually in s4; the generator never invents goal wording.
Test native document fields before custom code. Existing automatic plan rendering earns no new saving.
unknowns: Plan approval process and allowed access
research_questions: Can native rendering preserve the agreed plan while leaving collaboration and input capture effort unchanged?

incremental.description: Maintain plan fields and inspect rendering errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, plan period, goals, supports, responsibilities and final document version; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80; gross 20 less 4 upkeep gives net 16. Low is existing native plan rendering with no change; high requires 20 hours of observed repeat transcription. Assessment and collaboration keep their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult families and staff about learning and behaviour

steps.what: Provide consultation to parents, teachers and administrators about learning and behavior support

tasks.design: Keep professional consultation with the psychologist. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports advice; no automatic learning-style classification or added paperwork stage is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the child, context and what others have observed.
tasks.enabler_now: Documentation tools do not replace consultation judgement.
tasks.still_hard: General labels can distract from actual needs and evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist questions assumptions and adapts guidance to the situation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in consultation time or professional authority.

evidence.claim: Consultation remains professional dialogue; the task statement does not establish a separate note-production baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is the consultation conversation, excluding clinical assessment, separate case records and intervention delivery.
Parents and staff provide observations during retained s1. No machine step requires structured child profiles.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Typical consultation needs and follow-up duties
research_questions: Which questions require direct assessment rather than consultation alone?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; professional consultation remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce agreed-plan transcription while preserving community leadership, developmental explanation and individual consultation.
reach: Support research assistants with consistent intervention records
Work with counseling psychologists on family consultation
role.ambitious_version: A school psychologist who spends less time copying agreed plan details and retains direct attention to children, families and school communities.
